text:
Montreal got its captain back on Thursday and he picked up where he left off. Nick Suzuki returned against Utah after more than two weeks out of the lineup and had a goal and two assists in a 5-4 overtime win, stretching his point streak to five games. Karine Hains of The Hockey News had the goal: "Suzuki scores off a great Slafkovsky feed."

He has 15 points in 10 games. Last season, the one that ended with a Selke Trophy, he had 101. Evolving-Hockey rated him fourth among all forwards in 2025-26, and the reason was the two-way load: his competition ranked in the 99th percentile and he still took chances away from them.

Some of this pace is shooting. He's at 20% on 30 shots against a talent range near 15%, so the goals should slow, and Evolving-Hockey made a similar point about last season, when his results ran ahead of his chances. Our projection sits around 98 points. Watch his minutes in the next few games: he played about 20 on Thursday, a little under his usual workload.
headline: The captain is back, and so are the points
